summary: Person-only attention controls: attention.seen, attention.snooze and attention.dismiss on /v1/client/actions; attention rows carry seen_at and snoozed_until. In the TUI, `l` puts any Inbox item off for 3h through attention.snooze (hidden on every device of the person until snoozed_until; `l` on a snoozed item brings it back), replacing the device-only snooze; dismissing a request (x then y) sends attention.dismiss with each answer's note folded into its text, except that a request offering its own `dismiss` answer is still answered with it through work.done.

replay.detail: New person.attention-seen and person.attention-snoozed claims project into a rebuildable person_attention_controls table: earliest seen and newest snooze per (person, attention id) by canonical claim key, order-free across append, replication, replay and repair. A free-text ask now accepts the person's own dismiss answer (type feedback, outcome dismissed).

schema.detail: Two claim kinds on person/NAME (CapabilityHolder, person-only on local and replicated admission), the person_attention_controls table, and convergence corpus claims-v26. Client schema adds the three actions, their parameters, ActionResult.attention_control, optional seen_at/snoozed_until on Attention rows, and ErrorCode attention-dismiss-unsupported. Assistant attention rows are unchanged.

rules.detail: Only the subject person writes the new kinds, through the actions only. Agents and assistant grants are refused. Dismiss resolves an ask with outcome dismissed through the existing person response path; updates are read; other kinds, a mission step assigned to the person, and an ask that offers its own `dismiss` answer refuse with attention-dismiss-unsupported. A snooze never moves a deadline.

compatibility.detail: Additive: upgrade daemons before clients. Older daemons refuse the actions as unknown and do not admit the new kinds; older clients ignore the new optional Attention fields. ErrorCode gains attention-dismiss-unsupported, a non-retryable refusal; older SDKs decode it as unknown.

downtime.detail: The projection builds once on open from existing claims (none before this release).

recovery.detail: Revert the release; claims written stay in the log as unknown kinds on older builds and are harmless to them.
